title: Agentic-SQL Revisited: Autonomy-Based Taxonomy and Empirical Benchmark Analysis for LLM Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2608.15389v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based Text-to-SQL progress is reported across heterogeneous benchmarks, backbones, and inference protocols, making cross-system comparison fragile. We reframe the field as a leaderboard aggregation: we collect the metrics authors themselves report and organize them along an inference-autonomy axis spanning constrained, in-context, iterative, agentic, and reasoning-internalized generation, with traceable provenance for every cell. To anchor the aggregation empirically, we run a focused case study on Spider, comparing 8B open-source backbones with and without chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision against few-shot DeepSeek~V3 and GLM-4 baselines. Four patterns emerge: Spider gains transfer unevenly to BIRD and Spider~2.0; autonomy buys robustness at non-trivial cost; reasoning internalization sits between answer-only decoding and externally orchestrated agents; and CoT gains concentrate on Hard and Extra-Hard queries. translated_title: 代理式SQL再探讨：基于自主性的分类法与LLM文本到SQL的实证基准分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15389v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基于大语言模型（LLM）的文本到SQL进展在异构基准、骨干网络和推理协议中报告，导致跨系统比较脆弱。我们将该领域重新定义为排行榜聚合：收集作者自行报告的指标，并沿推理自主性轴（涵盖受限生成、上下文内生成、迭代生成、代理生成和推理内化生成）进行组织，每个单元格都有可追溯的来源。为了从实证角度锚定聚合，我们在Spider上进行了聚焦案例研究，比较了有无链式思维（CoT）监督的8B开源骨干网络与少样本DeepSeek V3和GLM-4基线。出现了四种模式：Spider上的收益不均地转移到BIRD和Spider 2.0；自主性以非平凡成本换取鲁棒性；推理内化介于仅答案解码和外部编排代理之间；CoT收益集中在困难和极难查询上。我们发布了一个Python工具包以促进可复现的基准分析。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于推理自主性的分类法来聚合文本到SQL的排行榜指标，并通过Spider案例研究揭示了自主性成本、推理内化位置及CoT收益分布等关键实证模式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an autonomy-based taxonomy to aggregate text-to-SQL leaderboard metrics and, through a Spider case study, reveals key empirical patterns including autonomy costs, reasoning internalization placement, and CoT gain distribution.
